Hi friend, it’s Jane Fonda.
We’re in the final stretch before Election Day, and New Mexicans are already casting their ballots. I can say with my whole heart that Deb Haaland is _exactly_ the kind of leader New Mexicans deserve in the governor’s office. She’s proven to be a fierce fighter for our climate, public lands, and communities – and I know she’ll bring that same tenacity to New Mexico as the state’s next governor. [**Will you please consider donating to her campaign right now to help fuel the final 5 days of her campaign?**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17370?refcode=jtk1696-fr-nd&t=1&akid=13563%2E400544%2E90esNR)

Deb has proven time and time again that when she believes in something, she doesn’t give up the fight.

In Congress, Deb fought to protect the lands surrounding Chaco Canyon from new oil and gas development. As Secretary of the Interior, she helped secure protections for the sacred cultural landscape that so many Tribal communities have fought to preserve. And during her time at Interior,_she helped protect more land and water than any administration in modern U.S. history – while simultaneously creating good-paying jobs in clean energy, conservation, and cleaning up legacy pollution._ **Right now, Donald Trump and his administration are hellbent on slashing environmental protections – even targeting Chaco Canyon. New Mexico urgently needs a governor who will fight back, not bend the knee.**
[**If you’re ready to elect a governor who will stand up to The Orange Man and never hesitate to put people above corporate greed, please make a donation to Deb’s campaign right now.**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17370?refcode=jtk1696-fr-nd&t=3&akid=13563%2E400544%2E90esNR)

| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142486090/657074853/-1024831887?refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6889&refcode2=23a99291-f5d3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2E5OTI5MS1mNWQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0SqENQcLFCjUC_xV1Wubld8stoa-YViOnQUPre3oyf0=)

Hey there,

I’m going to say something that a campaign manager probably isn’t supposed to 5 days before an election.

The worst thing that could happen to us right now is that people start believing we’ve already won.

Some polls in this race are looking good for us. Hey, I’ll take it. Sherrod’s supporters, friends, and family keep sending them to me with words of encouragement. It means a lot to know we’re building something so powerful together.

_But here’s why I’m still not sleeping well._

**WHAT I KEEP HEARING**

A poll from Marist had Sherrod up 48%-44% against his opponent. A few days later, Insider Advantage had them 47%-44%. Then, Echelon Insights reported that the race is dead even: 47%-47% with one week to go.

A lot of people are seeing these polls. There are more out there than ever, and at this point in a campaign, I can’t blame people for hoping that the positive ones are more accurate than the ones that say this is exactly tied.

The problem? I’m also hearing from some folks who are convinced this race is over. That we’re going to be fine. That we can just coast until Election Day.

And that’s my nightmare. Because anyone in politics will tell you that trusting polls can be your downfall. Folks remember 2016, right? I also remember 2024, and how devastating it was to be reminded that polls don’t win elections – votes do.

[**Will you help us keep the momentum on our side with a donation right now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142486091/657074854/-1260785309?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6889&refcode2=23a99291-f5d3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2E5OTI5MS1mNWQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0SqENQcLFCjUC_xV1Wubld8stoa-YViOnQUPre3oyf0=)

**THE MATH**

In 2024, Sherrod lost his race by about 3 points. That’s not a blowout by any means. It came down to just 33 votes per precinct. That sort of margin stays with you.

If we’re going to win this time around, we need to do everything right. We need to keep our voter outreach growing until polls close on November 3rd. We need to keep hosting events statewide to energize our base and get them out to vote. We need to spread our message to voters and combat the onslaught of attacks and lies Republicans are hurling against Sherrod.

Polling is a snapshot in time and it proves our campaign has a winning strategy. But practically every single poll I’ve seen has this within the margin of error. The most recent public poll has us tied, trending in the wrong direction. **The polls right now aren’t clear about who’s winning, but they do tell us with certainty that this is going to come down to the wire** – and I refuse to come up 33 votes per precinct short this time.

[**Will you help make sure our get-out-the-vote efforts are fully funded in this final stretch?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142486092/657074855/-1260785309?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6889&refcode2=23a99291-f5d3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2E5OTI5MS1mNWQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0SqENQcLFCjUC_xV1Wubld8stoa-YViOnQUPre3oyf0=)

**NATIONAL REPUBLICANS AREN’T LETTING UP**

Republicans’ playbook this cycle is more of the same corruption. They’re catering to out-of-state billionaires, corporate special interests, and loyalists to Donald Trump to try and buy another Senate seat and hold onto their power. Peter Thiel, Elon Musk, data centers, Big Pharma, all want to make sure this seat stays in the hands of someone who will put their interests over Ohioans’. They know that’s not Sherrod.

Total spending in this race has just passed $500 million. National Republicans account for $320 million of that. That’s 64%. It’s obscene. And it’s insulting to Ohio voters for them to think they can blanket our screens with lies and fear mongering – and win.

Donald Trump and JD Vance are all-in on winning in Ohio. That’s why the White House has held no less than 5 rallies here in a month. They wouldn’t be spending their time and money here if they didn’t think Jon Husted had a shot.

[**Will you help us fight back against the GOP money machine right now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142486093/657074856/-1260785309?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6889&refcode2=23a99291-f5d3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2E5OTI5MS1mNWQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0SqENQcLFCjUC_xV1Wubld8stoa-YViOnQUPre3oyf0=)

**WHAT NOW?**

I don’t blame people for looking at polls or analyzing early voting results. But election results aren’t a weather forecast we’re just waiting on. **We have the power to change the outcome.** Every day, we get to wake up and decide what we are going to do to make sure the results go our way.

So here’s my ask of you today. | | | | President Obama came to Atlanta last night to rally voters during the final week of early voting, and Georgia responded.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142486499/657084104/-1951883517?refcode=261029-obamarally&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzFlNmZhOS1mN2QzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Xo_RfBJtJX2OoSHWm5gMNNHcSnlR_qyN1BANmPbPRAE=)

I was proud to have President Obama here with us, and I’ll tell you something: I hope that if I win this race, he likes having me as governor of Georgia. _But unlike my MAGA opponent Rick Jackson, I will never say that I hope I am any President’s “favorite governor.”_ Because I’m not running for governor to be President Obama’s favorite, and I’m certainly not running to be Donald Trump’s favorite. I want to be the favorite governor of that single mother trying to figure out how she’ll fill up her gas tank and still put food on the table. I want to be the favorite governor of that Albany State student trying to afford his rent, textbooks, and groceries. That small business owner trying her best to get it off the ground and make her family proud. That farmer wondering how he’ll handle rising costs and supply chain issues during harvest time. subject: Big money to attack Greg Hull - Who is behind it?
body:
AND... will the real Dan Sullivan please stand up? | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/quV5CXvYxdb?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | Somebody is spending big money to attack Gregg Hull on TV. This week we found out who. It’s a pipeline company that wants to fuel a data center, and it’s backing the candidate who says she’ll ban them.
[Then we head to Alaska](https://us.list-manage.com/xrs9NQUX17r?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e), where there are two Dan Sullivans on the Senate ballot and only one of them is the senator.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ro5HCqcVzJD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | **💰 A PIPELINE COMPANY GAVE $250K TO THE PAC ATTACKING HULL**
The PAC is called Affordable New Mexico. Its biggest reported donor is Energy Transfer, the Dallas company behind the 17-mile pipeline that would feed Project Jupiter. The State Land Office has turned that pipeline down twice.
Mark met with Energy Transfer when he ran in 2022, and they wrote him a check. He explains why a company like that would back a candidate who says she’ll pause data centers, and why he can’t make the math work.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/2LZLCF10iIN?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **🗳️ TWO DAN SULLIVANS ON ONE ALASKA BALLOT**
Sen. Dan Sullivan is running for his seat. So is Daniel J. Sullivan Jr., a retired teacher from Petersburg. Alaska uses ranked-choice voting, so both names sit on the same ballot next to Democrat Mary Peltola.
JD Vance called it “the definition of electoral fraud.” A reporter asked him why Alaskans can’t just read the word “incumbent.” His answer is worth the clip.
This reminds us of 2022, when a former Republican ran as a Libertarian, and spent the whole campaign attacking Mark, and never said a word about the governor.**

****🥚 A MICHIGAN SENATE AD BLAMES ISRAEL FOR THE PRICE OF EGGS**
A PAC supporting Abdul El-Sayed put out an ad where a couple puts eggs and bananas back on the shelf because of aid to Israel. Mark calls it the worst political ad he has ever seen. Scott Jennings called it “economic incoherence wrapped up in antisemitism,” and Van Jones, sitting next to him, didn’t disagree.
We play the ad and let you decide whether it helps or hurts Mike Rogers.**
**
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/s06LNPyptS7?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | PLUS: Harry Enten says Republicans are gaining four points in key Senate races among likely voters, and we walk through what that does to Kansas, Iowa, Texas and Michigan. Trump is hitting 32 states before Tuesday, and a campaign insider explains the strategy. And Trump ended Biden’s methane rule in Lubbock, which matters less in New Mexico than you’d think.

I remember fondly my visit to the Sunshine State to watch the Space Shuttle Challenger launch in 1983, carrying Sally Ride, the first American woman in space. The stunning beaches, extraordinary wildlife, and vibrant communities make it one of the most remarkable places in the country. **And all of that is increasingly threatened by corporate pollution and the climate crisis. **I endorsed Jennifer Jenkins because she's exactly the kind of courageous leader we need in Washington.** She's a mom, an educator, and a fighter who isn't afraid to stand up to powerful interests.
In 2020, Jennifer defeated the co-founder of the conservative group, Moms for Liberty, to win a seat on the Brevard County School Board in a district Donald Trump carried by double digits. And when extremists came after her, she refused to back down.
**Now, she's taking on Republican Congressman Randy Fine, and she needs our help to win.**
Jennifer understands that Florida families are facing an affordability crisis, made worse by increasingly devastating climate disasters.
In Congress, she'll fight to lower costs, reform Florida's broken property insurance system, protect public education, and make sure working families come before wealthy special interests.

1\. Stephen Miller went on Fox News to rant and rave about me, JD Vance came to North Carolina to personally attack me (twice in two weeks) and President Trump has visited our state multiple times to campaign for my MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley.**

3\. Now, the GOP’s attacks are working: **Our momentum is slowing, and we’re falling short of our must-hit $5 million end-of-month goal.**
I need your help to fight back immediately so we can close the gap on our goal and stay on track to flip North Carolina’s crucial seat. **My team asked me to reach out to engaged supporters like you, so I’m personally asking:**

name: Bethany Mann for Congress
subject: What we're uncovering about Missouri's data centers
body:
Clean air, unanswered questions, and a troubling timeline

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Oxs5uZ2f8r8?e=519ef02502&c2id=654d9c3339d5694b9267d382db7ced0e)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friend,I've spent a lot of time lately talking with Missouri residents who are worried about the enormous data centers being proposed in their communities. They're asking reasonable questions about electricity costs, water consumption, air quality, public health, and the tax incentives being offered to developers.
These are questions that deserve thoughtful, transparent answers from the people elected to represent them.
Instead, I've been looking into something deeply concerning involving my opponent, Congressman Bob Onder.
On February 12, Onder introduced the CARBON Act, legislation that would remove carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide from the Clean Air Act's definition of air pollutants, limiting federal authority to regulate these greenhouse gases.
Around the same time, a close relative of Congressman Onder was pursuing a massive data center development in Ferguson, Missouri, with a proposed tax incentive package reportedly worth up to $1.5 billion.
Residents organized, attended meetings, circulated petitions, and challenged the proposed tax incentives. They wanted answers about the environmental and economic consequences of a project that could fundamentally change their community.
The timing of these developments raises important questions, and I believe those questions deserve public answers.
At a time when we should be strengthening environmental monitoring, testing for emerging contaminants, and learning more about the long-term effects of industrial development on public health, why is Congress considering legislation that would reduce federal oversight of greenhouse gas emissions?
As an environmental chemist, I've spent my career working with hazardous contaminants, including forever chemicals, and understanding what happens when dangerous substances enter our environment. I know how important it is to identify risks early, before families are left dealing with the consequences.
My team and I put together a short video examining Onder's legislation, the proposed development, and the questions Missouri residents are asking.
[**WATCH THE VIDEO**](https://us.list-manage.com/Mbbk3JLZVnB?e=519ef02502&c2id=654d9c3339d5694b9267d382db7ced0e)
**This is one of the reasons I'm running for Congress.**
I believe public service means listening when people raise concerns, demanding transparency when public resources are at stake, and making sure communities have the information they need to make decisions about their own futures.
It's also why I've been so intentional about how we fund this campaign.
**Approximately 96% of the money we've raised has come from within Missouri's 3rd Congressional District, with most contributions coming from individuals giving less than $150.**
We've raised significantly less than my opponent. Federal campaign finance records show that his campaign has received substantial contributions from political action committees and other organized political interests, including AIPAC's PAC.
Those financial relationships are public information, and I believe voters deserve to understand them.
Our campaign has chosen a different fundraising approach. We don't accept corporate PAC contributions, and we don't accept AIPAC money. We depend on the people who live and work in the communities we hope to represent.
That means we're careful with every dollar. Our small team researches legislation, attends community meetings, talks with residents, and works to make complicated issues understandable and accessible.
We may not have the same financial resources as my opponent, but I'm proud of what we've accomplished together.
If you appreciate the work we're doing, [**a contribution of any amount**](https://us.list-manage.com/dVdbGctHjlT?e=519ef02502&c2id=654d9c3339d5694b9267d382db7ced0e)**** helps us continue on with our critical final push to reach Missouri households, share important information, and make sure community concerns are heard.

A self-serving, out-of-touch billionaire would take our state backward — and we can’t afford that. So we need all hands on deck to cross the finish line and win this race. subject: 🚨 Election Day Is Days Away. I Need Your Help.

body:
LD2 is Arizona's most competitive legislative race. Please vote, volunteer, and help us reach every Republican voter before Election Day.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/3oyEYu5irIp?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)
| | | | | | Friends,As Election Day approaches, I wanted to take a moment to personally thank everyone who has supported our efforts across Legislative District 2. Whether you've volunteered, donated, attended an event, or simply encouraged others to vote, your involvement has made a difference.I'll be honest with you, these final days matter more than ever. Elections are won by the people who show up, and we cannot afford to leave anything on the table. LD2 is considered one of the key battleground districts in Arizona, and this race is incredibly tight. The outcome could be determined by just a small number of voters, making our grassroots efforts more important than ever. **That's why I'm asking for your help today.** If you can spare a few hours, please join our volunteer efforts. The most effective thing we can do right now is reach voters directly through phone calls, text messages, door knocking, and personal conversations. Every voter we contact could make the difference in a close race.
🙋 **Volunteer Today:**[ Join Our Volunteer Team](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=I%20can%20volunteer%20to%20help&body=)If you're unable to volunteer, a contribution to our final get-out-the-vote efforts can help us reach even more voters during these critical last days.💵 **Donate Today:**[ Support Our Final GOTV Efforts](https://us.list-manage.com/hcsYZ49iGYq?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)And if you've already voted, thank you. Now I'm asking you to help one more person make a plan to vote.

💻**Technology Roundtable: Arizona's Competitive Edge** Earlier this week, I joined business, technology, and community leaders for a roundtable discussion about Arizona's future. We talked about everything from artificial intelligence, data centers, and cybersecurity to workforce development and economic growth.As technology continues to transform our state’s economy, Arizona has a tremendous opportunity to lead. I appreciated hearing different perspectives and discussing how we can ensure our state remains competitive, attracts investment, and creates opportunities for the next generation.
**👩💻 Meeting with ASU’s Student Journalists 🧑🏻💻**Yesterday, I met with two undergraduate journalists from Arizona State University to discuss government accountability, transparency, and the Independent Oversight Committee for the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation & Reentry after Governor Hobbs eliminated its funding in the previous state budget.I enjoyed the opportunity to answer their thoughtful questions and have an honest conversation about the importance of independent oversight and public trust in government. My daughter-in-law graduated from ASU’s Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication. Many of their undergraduate coursework requires they conduct in-person interviews, so I was happy to carve out some time and accommodate their school schedule. Engaging with young people who care about public service and civic engagement always leaves me hopeful for Arizona's future. I also encouraged the students to tour a few of the re-entry programs helping formerly incarcerated individuals have that second chance.

❤️ **Arouet Foundation: The Importance of Second Chances** One of the highlights of my week was attending the Arouet Foundation's annual lunch earlier today. Arouet's mission is to help women rebuild their lives after incarceration and create a path toward stability, employment, and independence.Meeting the women and their families whose lives have been impacted by this work is a powerful reminder that second chances matter. Organizations like Arouet strengthen families, restore hope, and help build stronger communities, and I am grateful for the important work they do across Arizona.

🗳️ **Important Voting Deadline**
📅 Tomorrow, Friday, October 30: Last Day to Vote Early In PersonOctober 30th is the last day to vote early in person before Election Day. If you haven't voted yet, I strongly encourage you to cast your ballot on or before November 3rd.
📍 **Find an Early Voting Location:**[ Find an Early Voting Location](https://us.list-manage.com/1805RbKska0?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)If you are still holding onto an early mail-in ballot, you can take it directly to a polling location and present a valid ID. An election official can verify your identity in person and stamp your ballot envelope "ID Verified," allowing your ballot to bypass the normal signature verification process.At this point, you should no longer return your ballot by mail, as it will not arrive before Election Day. Instead, return it to a polling location or ballot drop box. Be sure to sign the affidavit envelope before submitting it. Our state’s laws require all ballots to be received by 7:00 PM on Election Day to be counted.
As I travel throughout our district, I'm reminded every day why I chose to serve. I've had the privilege of meeting so many dedicated people who care deeply about their families, their communities, and the future of Arizona. Your encouragement, your prayers, your volunteer hours, and your support mean more to me than I can adequately express.We are now in the final stretch, and every effort matters. **If you've been waiting for the right time to get involved, this is it.** If you've been wondering whether one phone call, one donation, or one conversation can make a difference, I can assure you it can.I'm personally asking you to do three things today: make your plan to vote, sign up to volunteer, and consider making a contribution to support our final voter outreach efforts.➡️ [Volunteer: Join Our Volunteer Team](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20volunteer&body=)➡️ [Donate: Support Our Final GOTV Effort](https://us.list-manage.com/cDdibSD8CYY?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)➡️ **Vote: Encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same.**
Thank you for allowing me to serve you in the Arizona Senate. It is an honor I never take for granted. Together, we've accomplished a great deal, and with your help, we'll finish strong and continue fighting for the values that make Arizona such a special place we call home.
Warm regards,Shawnna BolickState Senator, Legislative District 2

Did you see this?Trump just announced a new White House Women’s Health Task Force – and he put RFK Jr. in charge of it. _Yes, really._ Here’s my honest take on what this move means for women’s health:** ****It’s insulting – and worse, it’s dangerous. ** This is the same RFK Jr. who doesn’t believe in the HPV vaccine, which prevents cervical cancer in women. He also spreads misinformation about the science, effectiveness, and benefits of most other vaccines, too. He blocked teen pregnancy prevention funding, gutted maternal healthcare research, pulled us out of the World Health Organization, and defunded Planned Parenthood. **_And this is the same administration that has spent the last two years systematically dismantling the programs and research that keep women healthy. Now, just days before the midterm elections they’re terrified of losing, they want us to believe they care about women’s health? _** Last year, Republicans made the largest cuts to healthcare in our nation’s history, throwing more than 10 million people off Medicaid and spiking premiums for many millions more. All to bankroll $4.5 trillion in tax cuts for billionaires and massive corporations. Oh, and they carefully orchestrated the bill’s timing so its most brutal impacts take effect _after_ the midterms, when it’s too late to hold them accountable at the ballot box. Right here in Minnesota, we’re facing _double-digit increases_ in our health insurance premiums next year. But back to this bogus “task force” – I actually went to medical school. I spent more than 20 years caring for women as an OB-GYN physician. And I can tell you: _this is not what investing in women’s health looks like. _We don’t need a task force led by someone who is actively harming women’s health. We need to elect leaders who will invest in the research, our care, and our futures.**There are just five days until Election Day, so if we’re going to send a clear message that we won’t accept this anymore, I have to ask: will you chip in today to power our GOTV work in every corner of the district during the final push? subject: “Never be like these f****** losers who think the deck is stacked against them,” my grandma often told me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scalise for Congress
body:
I want to share a part of my memoir, Hillbilly Elegy
| Hey, It's JD. I want to share a part of my memoir, Hillbilly Elegy, which means a lot now as we enter the final sprint to Election Day.
"Mamaw and Papaw believed that hard work mattered more. They knew that life was a struggle, and though the odds were a bit longer for people like them, that fact didn't excuse failure. "Never be like these f****** losers who think the deck is stacked against them," my grandma often told me. "You can do anything you want to." \- Hillbilly Elegy, page 36
The liberal media, pollsters, and talking heads on TV are all spewing doom and gloom about the Midterms - they want you demoralized, and they want MAGA to give up because they are afraid of what happens when we show up to the polls.
Is it true that the DCCC is targeting 60+ vulnerable GOP seats across the map to destroy our pro-Trump Majority?
Yes, it's true. But if Conservatives think the deck is stacked against us and give up now, we're surrendering to the socialists who will sabotage the remainder of President Trump's term.

Folks, Every rally we hold, every door I knock, every town I visit to listen to those I hope to represent, I hear the same thing: the people are ready for change. More than a few people each day lean over to whisper to me, “You’ve got this. I promise you that we are going to pull off this victory.” Those whispers are quickly building into a roar – with yet another political outlet, Inside Elections, moving our race to a toss up, with polling and even prediction markets tilting our way. **CONCORD, N.H. —** Tonight, WMUR hosted the “Granite State Debate” between New Hampshire Governor Kelly Ayotte and Cinde Warmington. New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie released the following statement:

“Opioid Lobbyist Cinde Warmington proved tonight how unqualified she is for the corner office. Governor Ayotte demonstrated, once again, why Republican leadership in Concord matters,” **said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie.** “Governor Ayotte spoke about why the New Hampshire Advantage, with the second lowest tax burden in the country, has made New Hampshire the best place to live, work, and raise a family. Cinde Warmington has no solutions to make life better for people in our state — only lies and excuses for her decades of serving the opioid industry over Granite State families.”

We’re at a point in this race where we are making tough decisions that have a real impact on what we’re able to do in the final 5 days. Let us explain:

1. The latest poll shows this race is closer than anyone expected.

2. Republicans see this race as a top pickup opportunity, especially knowing New Mexico’s governorship tends to flip parties every eight years.

3. My Republican opponent is bankrolled by many of Trump’s TOP supporters in New Mexico and is focused on bringing Trump’s extremism to New Mexico.

Between now and Election Day, keeping our ads on TV, traveling across New Mexico, organizing events, and reaching voters takes real resources. And the closer we get to Election Day, the more quickly those decisions and investments have to be made. None of us want to look back the morning after Election Day wishing we’d done a little more. Because the stakes couldn’t be higher — for our working families, our public lands, and our kids’ and grandkids’ futures. That’s why you’re hearing from me personally — because what happens right now will shape what we’re able to do in the final stretch. Derek, I served this country flying KC-135s and RC26-Bs. I took an oath to the Constitution as a service member and a Congressman. I put my life on the line to defend our democracy and protect our fundamental rights.
So when Republicans cheered the January 6th Insurrection, tried to sabotage our elections, and gave Donald Trump powers more akin to a dictator than a President... putting my job on the line to protect our democracy was a no-brainer.
Meanwhile, cowards like Trump-darling Derrick Van Orden and 2020 election denier Tom Tiffany were all too happy bending the knee to the MAGA billionaire elite. They think elections can be bought, and they view Wisconsin as their personal power-grab. They have NO loyalty to their constituents – only to Trump and the MAGA machine.
**And that’s exactly why I’m asking for your help to stand with Wisconsin Democrats today.**
They need grassroots support NOW to defeat Tiffany and Van Orden and defend Wisconsin from a MAGA takeover in November. If we fail, we’ll have an election denier and a MAGA lapdog in charge of this critical swing state for the 2028 Presidential election... _**and that’s a disaster waiting to happen.**_
**We cannot let Tiffany and Van Orden take charge, Derek. Friend, I held a public town hall in Oakley, Kansas, last weekend.
People gave up part of their weekend to come, and they brought their questions with them.
607 days ago, Roger Marshall also held a town hall in Oakley. He called the crowd one of the rudest audiences he’d ever had, ended the event early, and walked out. He hasn't held one since.
Later he said town halls like this had become “nonproductive” and “dangerous.” I don’t believe that.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142488382/657120284/-540544497?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk945&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTllNjkzY2ItMTBkNC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjRkNGRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fjwXaWby4a4Ge38NJ0YcvB5NuuzgHNOe2K16bJLicFw=)
I looked out at that room and saw good, hardworking people concerned about important issues. Farmers worried about the cost of diesel and fertilizer. Parents trying to figure out how they’ll pay for healthcare. Neighbors looking out for families who are struggling to put food on the table.
We didn’t agree on everything, but we had an honest conversation about how I’ll fight for them in Washington. That’s what this job is, and Kansans deserve a senator who stays and listens.
**I would be honored to get to serve as our next U.S. senator — and I promise you, this is the approach I’d bring with me if elected. But right now, Nate Silver is calling this the closest Senate race in the entire country. That means I’m counting on grassroots support from people like you to fight back and win this thing.**

clean_body: It’s time we elect a senator who listens. | | | = Friend, I held a public town hall in Oakley, Kansas, last weekend. People gave up part of their weekend to come, and they brought their questions with them. 607 days ago, Roger Marshall also held a town hall in Oakley. He called the crowd one of the rudest audiences he’d ever had, ended the event early, and walked out. He hasn't held one since. Later he said town halls like this had become “nonproductive” and “dangerous.” I don’t believe that. = I looked out at that room and saw good, hardworking people concerned about important issues. Farmers worried about the cost of diesel and fertilizer. Parents trying to figure out how they’ll pay for healthcare. Neighbors looking out for families who are struggling to put food on the table. We didn’t agree on everything, but we had an honest conversation about how I’ll fight for them in Washington. That’s what this job is, and Kansans deserve a senator who stays and listens. I would be honored to get to serve as our next U.S. senator — and I promise you, this is the approach I’d bring with me if elected. body:
Abbott has failed all of Texas’s 254 counties.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Texas is a big state. **In fact, Texas has more counties than any other state in the country.**
With **254 counties,** from the Panhandle to the Rio Grande Valley, East Texas to the Hill Country, every community has its own story, its own challenges, and its own vision for the future.
But too many Texans have been left behind by Greg Abbott’s leadership.
**[We’ve got more to say, but first, can you pitch in $2.54 — a penny for each of the 254 counties Abbott has failed?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261029_5_254.uzzikx&refcode=em20261029-2584&amount=2.54&t=1&akid=2584%2E299639%2E6Bjc6h)**

Gina has traveled thousands of miles across Texas, sitting down with voters, listening to their concerns, and hearing what they need from their next governor.
She’s met teachers worried about the future of public education. Families struggling with rising costs. Small business owners trying to keep their doors open. Rural communities fighting to have a say in decisions that impact their land, resources, and way of life.
And everywhere she goes, Gina hears the same message: **Texans are ready for leadership that actually shows up.**
Greg Abbott has spent years prioritizing billionaire donors, corporate interests, and political insiders. But this campaign is about something different.
We’re building a Texas where every community has a voice and every family has a chance to thrive.
That’s why we’re building this campaign the grassroots way — one conversation, one supporter, and one county at a time.

name: DNC Chair Ken Martin
subject: Sorry for the early email, but I wanted to share a few critical updates before the weekend:
body:
We are officially 4 days away from the most consequential midterm election of our lifetimes. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10148%2E22930333%2E3dp7AS)
---
Derek, it’s Ken Martin. Sorry to be emailing you so early, but I have a few critical updates I wanted to share with you before the weekend. **As of this morning, we are officially _4 days away_ from the most consequential midterm election of our lifetimes.** I know there can be a lot of noise during big moments like this, but we can’t afford to get distracted right now. **So here’s what I’ll be paying attention to during the next 4 days:**
* **Early voting:** In some states, early in-person voting might be ending this weekend so officials can prepare for polling places to open on Election Day. And in other states, voters are still heading to the polls early or mailing in their ballots. **As of right now, more than _32 million Americans_ have cast their ballots in person or by mail.** But there’s still time to reach more Democratic voters to make sure they have a plan to vote on or before November 3 — _we don’t plan to let a single voter slip through the cracks if we can help it._
* **Voter turnout:** Our network of organizers and volunteers across key battlegrounds have already **knocked more than _3.3 million doors_ and made more than _7.8 million calls_** to make sure that _every last Democrat_ is able to cast their ballot this year. Lots of races could come down to just a handful of votes, so it’s more important than ever that we turn out every voter we can and make sure they have all the information they need to _get out and vote._
* **Voter protection:** Our team is building an army of volunteers who will ensure that Democrats can meet any threats to voting rights thrown our way head on. These volunteers will act as poll observers and make sure that the letter of the law is being followed at polling locations across the country. [**If you’d like to volunteer, please sign up here.](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/voter-protection-volunteer-survey/?source=em_20261026?refcode=em_20261030_10148_fr&t=6&akid=10148%2E22930333%2E3dp7AS)**

I’ll be honest, Derek: None of this work would be possible without the help of our team of grassroots supporters like you. _And with Election Day just around the corner, we need that team behind us more than ever._ [**We need to keep our eyes on the prize and remember what’s important in these final four days. So I’m asking: Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today to help power our work across the country knocking doors, making calls, and protecting voting rights in these critical final days?**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-eom-october-2026.a6x_w1&refcode=em_20261030_10148_fr&amount=7&t=7&akid=10148%2E22930333%2E3dp7AS) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89866?c0=em-dnc-eom-october-2026.gNKhUL&amount=7&refcode=em_20261030_10148_fr&t=8&akid=10148%2E22930333%2E3dp7AS)**

name: Abdul El-Sayed (via DNC HQ)
subject: Annoying.
body:
Our opponents and their special interest donors are counting on us to fail. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10146%2E22930333%2E_seXbn)
---
| [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-el-sayed-split.RVKDo5&amount=20&refcode=em_20261029_10146_fr&t=6&akid=10146%2E22930333%2E_seXbn)
---
Derek, I’m going to level with you. This is another fundraising email.
I know, I know... You probably didn’t wake up today thinking, “I can’t wait for Abdul to send me an email!” but I’m hoping you’ll give me a chance to explain why these emails are so important for our campaign.
I'm the only candidate in this race who has never taken a dime from corporate PACs, and never will.
As a result, I get to act independently and center this campaign around policies that working people actually want: **Medicare for All, abolishing ICE, using our taxpayer dollars to improve life here.**
But I have to be constantly fundraising, including in emails like this. I don’t like having to repeatedly ask for money – _but it’s the only way a campaign like ours can compete._
Our opponents and their special interest donors are counting on us to fail. If we slow down, it gives them an opening to flood this race with money and try to shut us down.
If we show up strong, we’ll have the resources to keep growing this movement and reach more voters across Michigan.
[**I don't expect you to give every time I email you. But this is a defining moment for our campaign, so I have to ask: Can you donate $20 or any amount to my campaign and the DNC today to help flip the Senate?**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-el-sayed-split.RVKDo5&amount=20&refcode=em_20261029_10146_fr&t=7&akid=10146%2E22930333%2E_seXbn)

name: Keisha Lance Bottoms
subject: Let’s make some history
body:
President Obama came to Atlanta Wednesday night to fire up voters during this final week of early voting, and Georgia showed up.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261030-1.Rvaw5l&refcode=em-20261030-1&t=1&akid=2223%2E1086043%2ErrbuVW)
I was proud to have President Obama here with us, and I’ll tell you something: I hope that if I win this race, he likes having me as governor of Georgia.
_But unlike my MAGA opponent Rick Jackson, I will never say that I hope I am any President’s “favorite governor.”_
Because I’m not running for governor to be President Obama’s favorite, and I’m certainly not running to be Donald Trump’s favorite.
I want to be the favorite governor of that single mother trying to fill her gas tank and still put food on the table.
I want to be the favorite governor of that Albany State student trying to afford his rent, textbooks, and groceries. That small business owner trying her best to get it off the ground and make her family proud. That farmer wondering how he’ll handle rising costs and supply chain issues during harvest time. That senior who’s being crushed by increasing property taxes.
I want to be YOUR favorite governor.
**[If you’re with me, I’m asking for your support as we push through the final four days of this race. We’re virtually tied in the polls, and we need every last penny to boost voter turnout. Will you contribute just $5 today, split between my campaign and Wes Moore, to help us win this thing and get to governing for Georgia families?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261030-1.Rvaw5l&refcode=em-20261030-1&t=2&akid=2223%2E1086043%2ErrbuVW)**

Thank you — from the bottom of my heart.
Keisha Lance Bottoms

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Following George Soros’ Money
body:
One of the most important investigations in our 32-year history.
| [ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86266&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=fffa336e79aefd927ba7cf7b028be6d6f4a116d26276d5fae33eb9c51644d232)
---
Dear Fellow Patriot, Your **Judicial Watch** has just released one of the most important investigations in our 32-year history... **_SOROS INC.: How George Soros ' Money and Network Are Working to Subvert America_** It exposes how George Soros and the radical network he funded and built are working to undermine and subvert our country. **I am not speaking metaphorically, nor am I exaggerating.** This is a deliberate, coordinated and exceptionally well-funded effort to seize the machinery of American self-government (the politicians, the prosecutors, the courts, the voter rolls, the streets) and bend all of it toward something the American people never voted for... and would never approve of. And the most important thing I can tell you is this: **the takeover attempt is not finished. It is well underway, but it is not complete, and it can still be stopped.** | [Help Expose the Soros Network ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86266&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=fffa336e79aefd927ba7cf7b028be6d6f4a116d26276d5fae33eb9c51644d232)
Here is some of what your **Judicial Watch** investigators uncovered:
* **America is the main target.** In 2024, Soros' Open Society Foundations spent _$242 million inside the United States_ , more than anywhere else on earth.
* **A $300 million war chest.** A fresh _$300 million initiative_ aimed at U.S. political operations, not foreign aid and not charity, with a reported $20 million routed to litigation groups.
* **An 800-lawsuit lawfare campaign.** More than _800 lawsuits_ against the current administration, filed in case after case by groups affiliated with, or bankrolled by, the same financier.
* **Soros-backed prosecutors.** At least _75 Soros-backed district attorneys_ , representing more than 72 million Americans, many undermining public safety with an anti-police, pro-criminal agenda.
* **Manufactured "protests."**_$7.6 million_ to Indivisible, the group running the nationwide "No Kings" movement, down to producing the standardized signs the crowds carry.

**These aren 't separate stories. They are part of one coordinated campaign to undermine the Republic, all funded by George Soros and his network of radical Left organizations.** Your **Judicial Watch** did not arrive at this story last week. We have investigated the Soros network for more than a decade, since long before it was fashionable to say his name out loud. Our 2018 investigation _traced the money_. Our lawsuits against the State Department and USAID _forced the disclosure_ of how his organizations were being funded by American taxpayers. We could not have followed the Soros network as far as we have, for as long as we have, **without patriots like you behind us.** **We do not assert what we have not proven. We investigate until the record is undeniable.** The Soros network depends on secrecy. Your **Judicial Watch** is already filing _expanded FOIA requests and lawsuits_ to follow the money through the Open Society network and expose its agenda. A compromised Congress and a dishonest media cannot be counted on to do this work, which is why an independent, patriot-funded investigation is so critical. So I am asking you to help fund the work: the investigations, the lawsuits, the exposure. None of it happens without patriots who turn conviction into the resources that make it real. **Your gift today helps carry this fight into its next and potentially most decisive phase.** And as my thank-you for your gift of any amount, **I 'll mail you your own copy of _SOROS INC.: How George Soros ' Money and Network Are Working to Subvert America, _**lever by lever, name by name, dollar by dollar, so you can read the full record for yourself. | [Fund the Next Phase ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86266&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=fffa336e79aefd927ba7cf7b028be6d6f4a116d26276d5fae33eb9c51644d232)
Our Soros work is not finished. That single fact is both the reason for hope and the reason for urgency. History will record who kept watch when it counted. **Let it record you.** Sincerely, Tom Fitton
President P.S. George Soros and his network never expected to face patriots like you, this vigilant and this determined to stand watch when it matters most. Please make your most generous gift today to help your **Judicial Watch** carry this investigation into its next phase. **With your gift of any amount, I 'll mail you your copy of _SOROS INC.: How George Soros ' Money and Network Are Working to Subvert America. _**Thank You! | [Make My Gift Now ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86266&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=fffa336e79aefd927ba7cf7b028be6d6f4a116d26276d5fae33eb9c51644d232)

body:

---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| **STEADY LEADERSHIP**
---
| Hi Friends,Kelly and I had a good time visiting with folks in Gillette and Laramie last week. We talked about agriculture and energy, learned about a business putting new technology to work in Gillette, and caught up with Wyoming neighbors while supporting our Cowboys and their win over Air Force. Go Pokes!There’s a lot of good work happening here. Agriculture, energy, and natural resources support our communities, and businesses are finding new opportunities. Our visit with the U.S. Department of Energy leaders, including Wyomingites serving in the Trump Administration, was a chance to discuss the importance of our coal, trona, and mining industries to our economy and the nation’s energy security. We need to support the work that has sustained Wyoming while making room for new ideas and good jobs.I’m grateful for the recent endorsements of Senators John Barrasso and Cynthia Lummis, Representative Harriet Hageman and Governor Mark Gordon, along with the Petroleum Association of Wyoming, the Wyoming Mining Association and Wyoming’s hospitality and tourism industry. From our first endorsement by the Associated General Contractors of Wyoming to those announced this week, I appreciate each one. Their trust, and yours, comes with a responsibility to follow through.We still have work to do before November 3. Wyoming needs steady leadership, and I’m asking for your vote. If you haven’t voted, please make time to stop by your county clerk’s office or make a plan for Election Day. We can’t take anything for granted.Kelly and I are grateful for your encouragement, your prayers and all the time you’ve given to help. We’ll keep showing up and working to earn your vote right through November 3.Eric
---
|
---
| **IN CASE YOU MISSED IT**
---
| **VIDEO MESSAGING** We have most of the videos we have created posted on our Barlow for Wyoming YouTube page, which should make it easy for you to access and share them. You can access the page [here](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M65H0EXVZPPXH9YQ1AMY65AJ_1)[

---
| **IN THE NEWS**
---
| | | **GILLETTE NEWS RECORD**[ Barlow Responds to Opponent's Criticisms on Legislative Record, State Government](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M65H0EXVZPPXH9YQ1AMY65AJ_5)
---
| **WYOMING PUBLIC MEDIA**[ Gordon Endorses Barlow as Election as Election Nears](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M65H0EXVZPPXH9YQ1AMY65AJ_6)**WYOMING NEWS**[ Wyoming Congressional Delegates Endorse Barlow and Gray](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M65H0EXVZPPXH9YQ1AMY65AJ_7)
---
|
---
| **On The Trail**
---
|
---
| **LARAMIE** Kelly and I were glad to join the Louisa Swain Foundation for the courtyard rededication at the Wyoming Women’s History House, recognizing Senator Lummis, Ray Hunkins, Jon Johnson, Diana Enzi and Bobbi Barrasso.Cassidy Post’s beautiful new mural helps tell the story of this historic building. We also appreciated the chance to visit with Ray and have him sign his Wyoming history book for us.Thank you to everyone who helped make the ceremony possible and continues to preserve and share Wyoming’s history!
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **LARAMIE** Appreciated the opportunity to visit with Acting Assistant Secretary Curt Coccodrilli and fellow Wyomingites serving in the Trump Administration, Amber Bland and Wendy Hutchinson. We had a good discussion about the importance of Wyoming’s coal, trona and mining industries to our economy and our nation’s energy security.
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| **LARAMIE** Great to be at the University of Wyoming as the School of Energy Resources celebrated 20 years last week. It was good to hear from former Governor Dave Freudenthal and recognize the important work SER is doing to support Wyoming’s energy industries, research and opportunities for future generations.
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **LARAMIE** Had a great weekend, and it started off strong with catching up with Wyoming neighbors from all over the state at the UW pregame festivities and throwing a few bags with the Wyoming Wrestling team at their cornhole tournament.The Cowboys are heading into the season ranked #11 in the nation, with three returning All-Americans! Thanks to Coach Mark Branch, his staff and the entire wrestling program for a fun afternoon.Go Pokes!
---
| | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | **GILLETTE** Kelly and I toured Xscindo in Gillette, and it was fascinating to see how they process electronics at the end of their useful life, with data security at the heart of their work.Thank you to the team for showing us how their technology supports secure data destruction and responsible electronics disposal. It’s great to see a company choose Gillette to put these ideas to work!
---
| | |
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | | |
---
| **GILLETTE** Kelly and I started one morning last week with the Gillette Leadership Breakfast, visiting with the Gillette Area Leadership Institute class as they focused on natural resources, energy production and agriculture.These industries play an important role in Wyoming’s communities and economy. Thank you for including us and taking time to learn more about the work that keeps our state moving forward!

---

Recent polling shows this race is a complete and total toss-up. And it’s going to take everything to keep our momentum going.

Tomorrow, we take off. Here’s how to make sure The Flyover lands in your inbox.

| | |
---
You're officially part of _The Flyover_ Crew. Welcome aboard! ✈️ We're glad you're here. Starting tomorrow, you can expect _The Flyover_ in your inbox each morning - a quick, engaging rundown of the stories worth knowing, without the corporate media agenda. It's designed to give you the important stuff without taking up your whole morning. **And yes, it 's free.** Want to see what you signed up for?[ You can read our latest edition here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71OwzAUQOGnsbdG9yfXhsEDS7ayMkZJfN0YOXWVmCLeHpWV7kefdD7O43nKJV8v79OmoaU6fh26jwTkTggnBhtDUiVlqwH9K3OPAmLXgITsIPo5Sv-SZscKKaJbkngFimJzeCgIDOBIQDq_4JxmZEHpE4s3PWjMre7dZ83XtmoqP_Wue7fUzZawtnY7DL8ZGgwN_xNDQ5maHs3QYPcQb9-5lHy4h3vZplz-nPZ06h7oNwAA___sn00L) Before we send you on your way, we have one small favor to ask.
### Help us make sure _The Flyover_ actually lands in your inbox.
Email providers sometimes have a mind of their own, especially when you've just subscribed to something new. Taking a minute to tell your inbox you want to hear from us can help make sure tomorrow's _Flyover_ edition doesn't get lost along the way. **The easiest thing you can do?** Hit reply to this email and let us know you got it. Even a quick "Got it!" will do. Then, depending on which email service you use, here's one more step you can take: **Gmail**
* On your phone: Tap the three dots (...) in the top-right corner, choose "Move to," then select "Primary." If you don't see Primary as an option, you're already set.
* On desktop: Go back to your inbox and drag this email into the "Primary" tab.

**Apple Mail**
* Tap our email address at the top of this email (next to "From:" on mobile), then select "Add to VIP."

**AOL Mail**
* Select "Contacts," then "New Contact." Add news@editor.jointheflyover.com and save it as a contact.

**Outlook**
* Hover over our email address at the top of this email, click the three dots, choose "Add to Outlook Contacts," then click "Save" or "Create."

**Use another email service not listed above?** You can find instructions for your email provider [HERE.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnMVus4-AgGRi6ZEvXjpZtDvsqHCKbBPXtq3TuA_yf9H_dhtsoWe7L57hxqKkMz4P3AQHdScPJgIohMSMbxUH7izFWE5BaAwFi8vrsx2TInVlDjN5eaJ6SczY5JeGtaDAADgmo97Oe0qQNabLJkO8scJRa9v67yL2unPJPefHez2VTOay1Po7OfHR47fDaWuvbKpWzHLVfnhK5w6vaQ3w0yVkO9_aWbZT819d_Z14BfwMAAP__SIVJ3g) And that's it. If you have feedback, a story you think we should cover, or just want to tell us what you think of The Flyover, email our Editor anytime at editor@jointheflyover.com. Thanks for joining us. We'll see you in your inbox!

name: Tim Burchett
subject: her agenda vs. mine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
Her base has a doorman. Mine has a dog on the porch.

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._tYog)
---
[A radical Democrat wants my job.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
I won't say her name. She's got an army of folks saying it for her, and not one of them could find Knoxville on a map.
---
[](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
Washington. New York. San Francisco. That's her base. That's her people. That's who's writing the checks - fat (or as the libs say, “pleasantly plump”) ones.
She's betting on one thing: that y’all won't look too close before November.
So let's look closely.
* Abortion: Not "reproductive healthcare." Not "choice." Not whatever focus-grouped label they're hiding behind this week.
* Trans surgeries on children: Kids too young for a tattoo. Too young for a beer. Too young to rent a car. Old enough, she reckons, for a scalpel.
* Gun Control: They'll call it "common sense" right up until somebody's reading names off a confiscation list. I'd bet the farm mine's at the top.

That's her agenda. Here's mine:
* I'll continue to chainsaw Washington's spending addiction as chairman of the DOGE subcommittee.
* I'll defend the Second Amendment as the God-given right it is — not a privilege some bureaucrat hands out.
* And I'll continue standing up for Tennessee values in a city that treats them like a punchline at a cocktail party.

That's the contrast in this race. Ain't close or complicated.
But I'd be doing you wrong to sugarcoat this, Peter: [a good record doesn't win elections by itself anymore.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
They've got the donors, consultants in three time zones, and a machine built to swallow districts like ours whole and never even burp.
The only thing between them and my seat is patriots like you, Peter.
[Please, chip in a few bucks right now and show them East Tennessee isn't a prize sitting on a shelf with a price tag hanging off it](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.).
---

Thank y'all for sending me here,

name: Ken Burns
subject: The choice is quite simple.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
We may not be able to outspend them. But we can outsmart them.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261030_1.6XTuGb&refcode=em20261030-1&t=1&akid=9854%2E582294%2EBaIsbz)
As someone who has spent a lifetime studying our nation’s history, if there is one constant lesson in our past, it’s that our republic is only as strong as the citizens willing to defend it.
And when you spend decades immersed in American history, you begin to see just how much it has to teach us about the moment we are living through today.
Our founders were trying to build a new kind of country – one in which citizens had the responsibility and the privilege to decide for themselves. They understood that Congress had a vital role to play in checking executive power.
_Today we are seeing what happens when that responsibility is abandoned._
Too many leaders have remained silent in the face of corruption, incompetence, tariffs, rising costs, and an executive branch accumulating more and more power.
Chris Pappas has not been silent.
**That is one of the reasons I am so proud to wholeheartedly support Chris for the United States Senate.**
This Senate race is a David and Goliath story.
We know Republicans are going to outspend us. We know millions of dollars from outside interests and billionaires are flowing into New Hampshire.
But they can’t buy the judgment of New Hampshire voters.
Granite Staters are smart enough to distinguish between the interests of billionaires and special interests and the interests of ordinary working people – the people struggling to afford healthcare, those having a hard time at the gas pump, and the small businesses being squeezed by tariffs.
**We may not be able to outspend them. But we can outsmart them.**
**[If you’re able please make a $5 contribution to Chris Pappas today and help him keep fighting for the people of New Hampshire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261030_1.6XTuGb&refcode=em20261030-1&t=2&akid=9854%2E582294%2EBaIsbz)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261030_1.6XTuGb&amount=5&refcode=em20261030-1&t=21&akid=9854%2E582294%2EBaIsbz)**
The choice before voters is actually quite simple. If you like the way things are going in New Hampshire and across the country – skyrocketing prices and reckless foreign wars – vote Republican. That’s who is in charge.
If you’re ready for change, I urge you to support Chris Pappas.
Just this once I hope we don’t reward silence in the face of corruption and incompetence with our votes.
Because this election is about more than one Senate seat. If Chris wins this open seat, Democrats have a chance to change the Senate and restore some of the checks and balances that are supposed to make our government work.
And that is what we need to be about: repair and restoration.
Abraham Lincoln once wrote, _“We cannot escape history.”_
We cannot escape this moment either. But we can decide what we do with it.
**[So please stand with Chris Pappas and do what you can to help him in these final weeks. This race matters, and Chris needs the resources to compete.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261030_1.6XTuGb&refcode=em20261030-1&t=22&akid=9854%2E582294%2EBaIsbz)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261030_1.6XTuGb&amount=5&refcode=em20261030-1&t=23&akid=9854%2E582294%2EBaIsbz)**
Thank you,
Ken Burns
Granite Stater and Filmmaker
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

clean_body: We may not be able to outspend them. But we can outsmart them. As someone who has spent a lifetime studying our nation’s history, if there is one constant lesson in our past, it’s that our republic is only as strong as the citizens willing to defend it. And when you spend decades immersed in American history, you begin to see just how much it has to teach us about the moment we are living through today. Our founders were trying to build a new kind of country – one in which citizens had the responsibility and the privilege to decide for themselves. They understood that Congress had a vital role to play in checking executive power. Today we are seeing what happens when that responsibility is abandoned. Too many leaders have remained silent in the face of corruption, incompetence, tariffs, rising costs, and an executive branch accumulating more and more power. Chris Pappas has not been silent. That is one of the reasons I am so proud to wholeheartedly support Chris for the United States Senate. This Senate race is a David and Goliath story. We know Republicans are going to outspend us. We know millions of dollars from outside interests and billionaires are flowing into New Hampshire. But they can’t buy the judgment of New Hampshire voters. Granite Staters are smart enough to distinguish between the interests of billionaires and special interests and the interests of ordinary working people – the people struggling to afford healthcare, those having a hard time at the gas pump, and the small businesses being squeezed by tariffs. We may not be able to outspend them. But we can outsmart them. The choice before voters is actually quite simple. If you like the way things are going in New Hampshire and across the country – skyrocketing prices and reckless foreign wars – vote Republican. That’s who is in charge. If you’re ready for change, I urge you to support Chris Pappas. Just this once I hope we don’t reward silence in the face of corruption and incompetence with our votes. Because this election is about more than one Senate seat. If Chris wins this open seat, Democrats have a chance to change the Senate and restore some of the checks and balances that are supposed to make our government work. And that is what we need to be about: repair and restoration. Abraham Lincoln once wrote, “We cannot escape history.” We cannot escape this moment either. But we can decide what we do with it. Thank you, Ken Burns Granite Stater and Filmmaker New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

## Titans Trade Simmons to Bears
The Titans traded All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons to the Chicago Bears on Thursday, pending a physical, in a [historic deal](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFupDAQxvGnMZ2RPQMsFC6uodtrr0S2GcAnY1b2CLRvH5FEeYF0U_01v-_fc3raEENa_9qdDPMyJbpKJGbKEwe2qXC2M5Ww70cq3mammCdQ0EmtJKrJeg4nTY2tZuNAD7bxFRn9GBDbZtBdtRlEbLVzSwfY9gsC9S2g7wcP2M8OfBXMHdQKlVaqR6xVo_uhda6ZFdICTjSK5sBHrnkjppSoFKIlvo-Tcu2PvYpmY34VgX8EjALG67rq64xc8ylgvPMCRq3uexAw_jTkF1LeypBWaWOUr3zI_7QslN_yGy79FrxdD-nI5iJgrLKZX1eIMZTuIRq17jbEz0_4lzOeBj4CAAD__wMrh6A) aimed at rebuilding the franchise. Tennessee gets Chicago's first-round picks in 2027 and 2028 plus a 2027 fourth-rounder, while sending a 2028 fifth-rounder with Simmons. He's reportedly the first defensive tackle since 1967 traded for multiple first-round picks. Simmons spent his entire career in Tennessee after the Titans drafted him at the 2019 NFL Draft in Nashville. He became the league's [highest-paid defensive tackle](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0T3OnDAQxvHTQDfIX3ihoEhD96ZNicb2eHFk8MqeLNrbR7uJcoG0o9Ff-un58bV9YcrpvH_HgxbmuJ10tUzMVDdOjGfjioFaOo5yNo-VKddNCWVBCtBiQ8_pSZvBPixOyRmN72mRt1nr0czS9vvikW7T5NGPbhazNCPJWWIQcQzGGrR9Wt5BKbSQQkxaD8LIaR6dM0Foisp1RlBIXOrAOzGdJ7VGFPOrPKkOvhx9XnbmR-v0t06tnVqv6xpy8Zj1G_R-6dT6OUB7lMqtU-u_EPyRwocKmDM8aoHA8JNipPqCv3zgAn5PHu8FHGFtEEsFvgrEVBtDLb_O0KkVKyefaZtQOT36CM64AGacCVw0FgRaaZH8FKwcdj5yX5fwuFLOqdlbZ8T9wJQ_Lv7PUZ6L-h0AAP__MlOkzw) this past offseason. Owner Amy Adams Strunk said, _" He gave Nashville more than football."_ The 1-6 Titans visit Cincinnati on Sunday.
## 24 Charged in Cartel-Linked Drug Ring
Twenty-four people face [federal charges](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ8GOq_GP8BSuEhDd9OmRIM9wGiNWdmTRXn7iOQRbjuac_R959fX_IWcOG8_8SAvss6ZrppIhMosLJirFIxU-TjOXAMWoVRmA6ZXGpSFGYPwh2aHbfSL0SO60JLXw2ht50bdt7vXvR3IQAeDMTrQE_Sge1hGsstiYR1b9nehBgsa4GntA5x-jt2yuAiWVrM0DiiynOUhOwnlTLUSrenP-aHyCOfRJr-LvGtjfzRmasx0XdfjVgk75kypu58aM92nxkzGqbBj2SgqzqpyxnSi-m-nEucXRRXL701JwXXl8OK8qfNNBYXPfGcOjjGRulna4uP74pS49kPjYDuQ0z8o-eaiH2_-BgAA___8aY2n) in a Nashville-based drug ring with alleged ties to Mexico's Sinaloa Cartel, prosecutors announced Wednesday. Two alleged leaders, Humberto Morales, 34, and Jose Martin Perez, 30, are accused of helping direct the operation from inside Tennessee prisons, where they were serving time for unrelated convictions. Investigators seized more than [500 kilograms](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0TuO2zAQxvHTSN0YfFkyCxVp1G3alMKIHNmD5cMgJ9rN7QMn2Fwg9QB_zA_fj7ftDTlxuX_HTIvIsRX66IlEqG3CgqVLw0idc66lB2xCqW1GmQm0Aqs2DMInbQ7HuOxGe3RhpEXP3tqr83oaH4vyqAJ570jb2zzdXPDHdVeT1X6eo7-OvLyCWlmllbpZe1FO3_x1311Ulg6zD05RZKntIg8SKoV6JzrSr3pSu4Sax7Q8RJ59sN8Gsw5mPeqnnl-Xwawv0mDWVAOmwazGAZfIQSgCF8j0yQEL_LVB4vJOEWL7eQdpeBwc3rncoT6poXAtgKHV3iFzjIng3zfQuWCq-BX6SlfI5RmhYH-cnBKNbYnPD06J-zQPTt0zcvpjkP8c4FzM7wAAAP__thufUQ) of methamphetamine, 20 kilograms of fentanyl, 60 kilograms of cocaine, and more than $375,000 in cash. Seven suspects were arrested in Nashville, Mt. Juliet, Cookeville, and Stockton, California. If convicted, most face at least 10 years in federal prison. All 24 are presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
## Facebook Deer Hunt Guide Owes $60K
A Somerville man must [pay $60,000](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLvOnTAQhJ8GOh-tL9wKF2no_rQp0YIXWMnYyN7_HOXtI1LkBdJNMRp98_36Wr6QI6fjJ17kRfYl0adGEqGyCAumKgUDVb6unOqGRSiWxYDplQZlYcFN-E2Lwzb41egJ3daS18Nkbecm3benp24dYDPYjxr3DnuHLgSNg4Zgte6Glv0zqMGCBhitfYHT49StqwtgaTdr44ACSy4vOUkoJaqVaI-_85vKa8tXG_0pctfG_mjM3Jj5ubGdmBLF6Sk0Zq53LlIbM-dvCTmXJ8onq4uS2jlRUGMPAGrPRXGMdGBUgaio8zsJp0PlmwoK56Q4qX8UbfHh_nCMXPuhcXBcyPEvk_yn0Lc3fwIAAP__HgaNkw) and quit hunting for five years after guiding illegal deer hunts he advertised on Facebook. Austin Elrod, 30, led hunts in Fayette County [without a guide license](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZEbttoeBwMElZHPphcjGDfhkzMjuBc3fr9hf2KykJ1WV3r_X9HIxxbz-dTtZ5mXKdNVEzFQmjuxy5eIC1bjvR66zK0ypTAjYSQVSw-RmjidNxjXBelSDM3NDVj0HrR9mUF2zWYQASBqVmftOLX7pvTJPornDQakHNNHehQo0KIBe6xaM6oeH9yaApgW9MEAh8lFa3ogpZ6qVaEmf46TSzsfeJLsxv6vQfwSOAsfrutrL-_983ljgeC8IHBXcuRc41mOncsaUSO4uy6MEKhTk231kBwAgb7S6JANRkdtX5phXObtKAsem2PC-Ykqxdk9hYN1dTD9H-JcWT4vfAQAA___BcIXA) during the 2021 and 2022 seasons, and seven deer were taken illegally. A Georgia client with no Tennessee license killed five of them and took them home. Fayette County is a designated zone for chronic wasting disease, which is fatal and contagious among deer. A federal judge sentenced Elrod to probation, a $40,000 fine, and $20,000 in restitution. The Georgia hunter was ordered to pay $26,000 and lost his hunting privileges for 18 months.

**A Note from Cole, CEO of _The Flyover_** Dear Reader, Every year, auditors count how many copies America’s biggest newspapers actually put in people’s hands. The new numbers are brutal. Of the 25 largest papers in the country, 24 shrank last year. Average decline: 12.5%. Nearly a quarter-million daily papers, gone in a single year. _The Denver Post_ now prints about 24,000 copies a day. _The Arizona Republic_ , 33,000. _The Houston Chronicle_ , 35,000. _The Dallas Morning News_ , under 40,000. These are metros of millions. And the steepest collapse in the country belonged to _The Washington Post_ : down 21% in a single year to fewer than 88,000 print copies. Trust in the media now sits at the lowest level ever recorded. So no, that’s not an audience drifting away. That’s a jury coming back with a verdict. body:
Charlie said it best in the days leading up to President Trump’s victory in 2024:

| | | |
---
Friend,
---
Charlie said it best in the days leading up to President Trump's victory in 2024: _" I don't care about polls. __ __I don 't care about betting markets. __ __I don 't care about vibes. __ _ **_I care about how many ballots are in the box. _**_ __If we turnout, we win. __ _**_Do the work. " _** Do the work... Charlie knew there was no easy route to saving our country. He knew there were no shortcuts to victory. He wore a red band on his wrist every day -- a reminder of what it would take -- that read, _**" Be Better. Work Harder." **_ It wasn't just for motivation. Charlie lived by those four words, and he expected every one of us at Turning Point to live by them too. In fact, the standards that Charlie built this movement on still hang on the walls inside our headquarters:
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-OnDAMxp8m3Bg5cQhw4FB1hNTD7rXHyCRmiAqEJmHm9Su28wR7s-zP389_fn_YDwpr2B-ftPHgnsGmbMvCczzTKyaf3UJpDfyKieNuFShTS6gRLLkSnmw1VX5w3qCqeJBtj9g0iF21DA0QzIaU7iYFjIgdEmrN_Yw9EVIVhstOAoIE2SDcQCP1CvpJG9kRgNBwHp4K55uLe-b0pIsZ9j1eUdxvLm7VOiylHFngD6FGocbM7kx8o519LJdCqLEc17hxF2rEaeK5Mb5utTK17mZZ9xrmuueubY1BNkoKHHM8k2PromeB95-_PmWDjZFCmbNsdmMfzk3gnTcK6zv5v0XgfaHkKf-x5P6-S462g8JjF3gvB9mJ1jUW6xbKnPLXVd_CwumyrdLgj1dY15BNKzQ8LszXtuWbT3oO6l8AAAD__-HcoOg)
---
Those banners were never meant just for the people on our staff. Charlie meant them for anyone who ever said they'd fight for this country. And that includes patriots like you, Friend. Because right now, the midterms are coming down to the wire. _Nearly every battleground state or district? _ Tied. A dead heat. Within the margin of error. **And just as Charlie said... when it 's that close, only one thing matters: How. Many. Ballots. Are. In. The. Box. ** That's why our ballot chasing teams are working around the clock in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire to beat the Communist Left this November.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-OnDAMxp8m3Bg5cQhw4FB1hNTD7rXHyCRmiAqEJmHm9Su28wR7s-zP389_fn_YDwpr2B-ftPHgnsGmbMvCczzTKyaf3UJpDfyKieNuFShTS6gRLLkSnmw1VX5w3qCqeJBtj9g0iF21DA0QzIaU7iYFjIgdEmrN_Yw9EVIVhstOAoIE2SDcQCP1CvpJG9kRgNBwHp4K55uLe-b0pIsZ9j1eUdxvLm7VOiylHFngD6FGocbM7kx8o519LJdCqLEc17hxF2rEaeK5Mb5utTK17mZZ9xrmuueubY1BNkoKHHM8k2PromeB95-_PmWDjZFCmbNsdmMfzk3gnTcK6zv5v0XgfaHkKf-x5P6-S462g8JjF3gvB9mJ1jUW6xbKnPLXVd_CwumyrdLgj1dY15BNKzQ8LszXtuWbT3oO6l8AAAD__-HcoOg)
---
They're out knocking doors, making phone calls, registering voters, training new volunteers, and once voting opens, they'll chase down every last ballot they can. But as hard as they're working, we still don't have enough of them. Don’t go to sleep on election night wishing you did more.

| | | | Friend,
---
Don't go to sleep on election night wishing you did more. That's the standard our Turning Point Action team is holding itself to. Right now, they're all gas, no brakes, and I couldn't be more proud of them. Everything this team is doing is more than just showing up right before November, because that's not what actually wins elections. It's about building real connections while reaching voters where they are, in their neighborhoods.
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkb_OozAMwJ8mbFQmgQQGhpMqtu-G00k3Rq5jSlQgXDDt65_o9QW-wYt_9k_-8-fLf2Gc43r_iQv3WUafdz-z7CHJxK-UH5JecfUatC0rKA14JIlP9jUWoQ8UsKKC-8p1xjRWG1dMPbWmA2o1uOCw6bABG7gJPFYanYOmiP3pq8DAGQYubYfg3M2OjTHOOatqwJmzXDJvx22OhKvg_hhTJr5QWoq5n0S2XZkfSg9KDzvTkfmCK4ckZ4XSg2znqGlVeqjpNtYQdOna2pU1UF22FtsyhLED1rYFvCkz7OnIxJ5SYGWuv34PVWNcVyltD1n8wiEeizJXXjDOn-T_FmWuE-aA-8Mj_f0gwmXDeF-VucqG7xN6kueHCufTVeQ-bK84z3G3TtVwP93vFeW773j2-l8AAAD__3xdlfM)

Charlie wanted voting to become a habit for every America-loving patriot in this country, and our team is making that dream a reality, one front door at a time. Here's a look at what our team is doing on the ground right now: ✅ Hosting over 500 Super Chase events nationwide up until Election Day, activating people to chase votes in their own communities. ✅ We have trained and deployed 850+ full-time ballot chasers across key states, and the number is increasing by the day. ✅ Making sure voters in key states have a plan to submit their vote, through the work of our Chase the Vote team. ✅ Working day and night at headquarters so our field teams have everything they need to identify and reach every possible voter. ✅ Calling, texting, and writing postcards to voters, and hosting community events to get out the vote. ✅ Developing the "Freedom Ticket" as a personalized voter guide for patriots to use at the voting booth in key battlegrounds. ✅ Building permanent infrastructure in the new "Red Wall" states of Arizona, Nevada, and Hampshire. When I see this machine at work, I see Charlie's vision growing stronger across America.
